plugins.name: FlashSpeed
plugins.description: Remove WordPress bloat before it reaches visitors. FlashSpeed lets you disable unused scripts, styles, discovery links, and optional features one switch at a time—without replacing your cache plugin.

plugins.name: SaleSaver
plugins.description: Recover failed WooCommerce orders before they become lost revenue. SaleSaver sends branded follow-up emails, prevents duplicate messages, tracks recovery, and keeps unsubscribe handling built in.

plugins.name: Sitemapster
plugins.description: Give search engines a clean, cached map of your posts, pages, and images. Sitemapster creates local XML sitemaps with pagination and independent controls—without a heavyweight SEO suite.

plugins.name: Sky Changelog Notifier
plugins.description: Know what changed after every automatic update. Sky Changelog Notifier adds the relevant plugin or theme changelog to WordPress update emails, so maintenance decisions take minutes—not detective work.

plugins.name: Sky Login Redirect
plugins.description: Send every user to the right place after login or logout. Sky Login Redirect handles roles, individual users, WooCommerce flows, previous-page returns, and loop protection without custom code.

plugins.name: SpamJam
plugins.description: Stop automated comment and registration spam without CAPTCHAs. SpamJam adds layered, on-site protection with no puzzles for real visitors and no remote spam-scoring dependency.

plugins.name: Typo Reporter
plugins.description: Turn readers into proofreading partners. Typo Reporter lets visitors flag a typo in seconds and gives you a focused WordPress queue with the original text, suggestion, post, and URL.
